card.name: Space before duration numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly the blank space token right before a number of days or hours, as in 'duration of treatment is' or 'infusion over'. Also the end of 'Hypo-thesis' and a few spots where 'to' follows 'used'.

modes.label: Space before duration
modes.description: Space token just ahead of a number of days or hours for treatment length or infusion time.
modes.example: The recommended duration of treatment with FETROJA is<< >>7 to 14 days.

modes.label: Hypothesis words
modes.description: Ending of 'hypothesis' in statistics text, or 'to' before model comparison.

card.plain: It fires on the gap just before a number of days or hours in antibiotic dosing text, and on the word hypothesis in statistics.
